1.title: CVE-2026-120382 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: An improper neutralization of argument delimiters in a command vulnerability in the OAuth API in Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) before 7.1.1-42962-10, 7.2.1-69057-14, 7.2.2-72806-11, 7.3.2-86009-6, and 7.4.1-90080-2 allows remote attackers to read or write arbitrary files and conduct denial-of-service attacks.

1.title: CVE-2026-134882 (CVSS 10.0)
1.summary: A weakness has been identified in TOTOLINK A7100RU 7.4cu.2313_B20191024. This issue affects the function exportOvpn of the file /cgi-bin/cstecgi.cgi of the component CGI Handler. This manipulation of the argument Username causes os command injection. The attack is possible to be carried out remotely.

1.title: CVE-2026-135208 (CVSS 9.8)
1.summary: Kerberos Agent before 3.14.4 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability that allows unauthenticated attackers to forge administrator tokens because JWTMiddleWare() falls back to the hard-coded key TOBECHANGED. Attackers can sign HS256 tokens with arbitrary username and role claims to access /api and /config routes, exposing RTSP, ONVIF, Hub and encryption keys, rewriting configuration, and stopping the camera.

1.title: CVE-2026-135429 (CVSS 9.1)
1.summary: Tabbycat 2.9.0 through 2.12.1 contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability in TournamentViewSet that allows unauthenticated attackers to gain write access because PerTournamentPermissionRequired returns True for views lacking a tournament attribute. Attackers can send POST, PUT, PATCH or DELETE requests to /api/v1/tournaments to create, modify or delete tournaments, cascading deletion to teams and speakers.

1.title: GHSA-2r3w-c2vx-fv5g — Xen Orchestra: Empty-object login token
1.summary:
### Summary

REST cookie parsing turns `authenticationToken=j:%7B%7D` into `{}`. REST authentication passes that object to the XO token provider without requiring a string. The token collection treats `{}` as an unfiltered lookup and returns its first token; the provider authenticates as that token's owner if it is unexpired. The authenticated `/rest/v0/users/me/authentication_tokens` route then returns reusable login token IDs.

1.title: GHSA-mqwm-5m85-gmcv — Gradle causes failure to disable repositories exposing builds to malicious artifacts
1.summary:
### Impact

When resolving dependencies, Gradle searches repositories in declaration order. If it encounters connection errors, Gradle will disable the repository and fail dependency resolution. This is necessary for both reproducibility and security reasons to prevent dependencies from being resolved from other repositories without warning.

Admittedly, the content is less smelly and easier to handle, but the work still has to be done. The result is V30.11, packed with technical corrections, updated code, and new material.
